definitions.explanation: A flash of light in the sky during a storm.

examples.japanese: {雷|かみなり}が{鳴|な}っている。
{遠|とお}くで{雷|かみなり}の{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of thunder in the distance.

examples.japanese: {雷|かみなり}が{怖|こわ}くて、{布団|ふとん}の{中|なか}に{隠|かく}れた。
examples.english: I was scared of the thunder and hid under the covers.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に{空|そら}が{暗|くら}くなって{雷|かみなり}が{光|ひか}り{始|はじ}めたので、{急|いそ}いで{家|いえ}に{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: The sky suddenly got dark and lightning started flashing, so I hurried home.

notes:
{雷|かみなり} means thunder and lightning.

ETYMOLOGY:
{神|かみ} (god) + {鳴|な}り (rumbling) - the rumbling of the gods

EXPRESSIONS:
- {雷|かみなり}が{落|お}ちる: lightning strikes; to get yelled at
- {雷|かみなり}{親父|おやじ}: strict/angry father

COMPOUNDS:
- {落雷|らくらい}: lightning strike
- {雷雨|らいう}: thunderstorm
